channel.title: Game news | CTRL+A GAME
channel.description: Verified gaming news from every platform: launches, free games, deals and updates. Every story links to its official source.

item.title: MOUSE: P.I. For Hire is 34% off until November 27
item.description: The game's official Steam news post asks players to vote in five Steam Awards categories, and a sale runs alongside.

item.title: Zombies Aren't Real lands on Mac with Update #2
item.description: The Steam announcement says the patch reworks the Gunship, adds a co-op ownership view and brings two new languages.

item.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV launches December 3
item.description: Commander Edition pre-orders get three days of early access from November 30, and two expansions follow in 2027 with new campaigns.

item.title: Warframe nominated at The Game Awards 2026: voting ends December 9
item.description: According to Warframe's Steam announcement, fans can vote through a Google, X or Facebook sign-in on the nomination page.

item.title: WARDOGS warns against NVIDIA drivers 621.14, 621.24, 621.35
item.description: The developer advises skipping NVIDIA drivers 621.14, 621.24 and 621.35 and rolling back to 617.42 if the game stutters.

item.title: The Regreening launches December 7 on Steam
item.description: Restore a deserted world by growing plants, rebuilding wildlife habitats and upcycling junk, with no timers to rush you.

item.title: Sea of Remnants hits Xbox Series X closed beta on December 3
item.description: The free-to-play turn-based roguelike opens pre-download on December 1 for Xbox Insiders, and the test ends December 18.

item.title: ROB RUN explores hardware bans and stricter servers
item.description: The developer says over 200,000 accounts are blocked, and separate servers with stricter access are planned to launch first.

item.title: Queen's Domain sells 300,000 copies in 3 weeks
item.description: The developers announced 300,000 copies sold on Steam, and Eurogamer gave the action-RPG a 5/5 review.

item.title: Path of Exile 2 soundtrack tracks arrive on Spotify
item.description: Tales of Oriath, a selection from the Path of Exile 2 soundtrack, is now streaming on Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal and YouTube Music.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: Xbox Cloud and Remote Play guide
item.description: An Xbox Wire guide explains how to play GTA VI via Xbox Cloud Gaming and Remote Play on phones, PCs and handheld gaming PCs.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI hits 39 million players on PS5
item.description: PlayStation says Grand Theft Auto VI logged 683 million hours on PS5 in its launch window and set a concurrent player record.

item.title: Counter-Strike 2 fixes Cobblestone bomb and wall bugs
item.description: Valve's Steam announcement says the update fixes unreachable bomb spots, bad boosts and grenades falling through the map.

item.title: Crimson Desert open for Steam Awards 2026 nominations
item.description: Players can nominate Crimson Desert on Steam from November 23 to 30, including for Game of the Year and other categories.

item.title: AION 2 Season 2 starts December 16 with new Brawler class
item.description: The roadmap covers the Brawler class and housing arriving in January 2027, though some timing may change.

item.title: 007 First Light gets 50% off on Steam
item.description: Players can nominate 007 First Light for The Steam Awards 2026, and the announcement lists no end date for the discount.

item.title: Worst Class Ever passes 1 million copies sold
item.description: The developer shares its update roadmap

item.title: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS College Royale Fall 2026 finals are live
item.description: The top 16 college teams play five live final matches on November 22 for a share of a $15,000 scholarship pool.

item.title: Just Volleyball developer maps out save recovery, ranked plans
item.description: Players who lost save data should keep screenshots now and open a ticket to request restores after the next update.

item.title: Everyone's Tier List! passes 20,000 sales
item.description: The developer says the game sold more than 20,000 copies within ten days of its 12 November launch, and a 15% discount runs through 26 November.

item.title: Dungeonbound 1.0.14 adds Jerry and new anti-cheat
item.description: Steam's official announcement says the update adds the hero Jerry, a slot machine shrine, server-side cheat detection and balance changes.

item.title: European cruisers arrive in Early Access
item.description: A 4v4 Brawl session and the Origin of Terror operation join this weekend.

item.title: War Thunder screenshot contest 251 focuses on rockets
item.description: Submit raw in-game shots tagged #WTscreen251 by November 27.

item.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin update fixes quest and display bugs
item.description: What the November 21 update changes

item.title: Here Comes the Horde 1.2.0 adds a prestige system
item.description: Restart the campaign and earn Corrupted Hearts.

item.title: ARK's Turkey Trial event runs November 25 to December 1
item.description: Boosted rates and turkey-themed cosmetics.

item.title: Dodge Viper GTS and ACR preview for American Truck Simulator DLC
item.description: Details on the Viper models in the Road Trip: RAM & Dodge DLC.

item.title: AION 2 adds World Market and World Exchange on November 25
item.description: Cross-server trading opens after maintenance on November 25.

item.title: Zenless Zone Zero Version 3.4 launches December 2 with free S-Rank Robin
item.description: The Finality of the Day adds Void Hunter Sunbringer, a Honkai: Star Rail crossover, free Robin, and Bangboo Pom-Pom.

item.title: Ten new games are coming to Xbox from November 23 to 27
item.description: Release dates and short previews
